clue.text: Quiet corner where business is booming

parts.note: pacific means peaceful or quiet
a rim is an outer edge, taken loosely as a corner or border

explanation.surface: A peaceful nook turns out to be a place where trade is thriving.
explanation.walkthrough: The PACIFIC RIM is the ring of countries bordering the Pacific Ocean, famous for booming economies; 'Quiet corner' looks like a calm spot, the opposite of booming.
explanation.definitionFit: The countries bordering the Pacific Ocean have been the world's fastest-growing economic region, a byword for commercial boom.

clue.text: The best hacker?

definitions.meaning: the ... of the bunch is the finest

explanation.definitionFit: A pick is both the choicest selection and a tool for hacking at hard ground.

clue.text: Openness and positive attitude at old settlement

parts.note: a can-do attitude is positive
Ur was an ancient city of Mesopotamia

explanation.surface: Frankness and optimism are found at an ancient town.
explanation.definitionFit: Candour is frankness and openness in speech.

clue.text: Gloss from one of many Brussels interpreters?

definitions.meaning: a high-shine finish for wooden furniture
a translator between two EU languages, as at the Brussels institutions

explanation.definitionFit: French polish is a glossy shellac finish for wood, and whimsically a French-Polish interpreter at the EU.

clue.text: Boat clubs, say

definitions.meaning: golf clubs can strike the ball with a cutting stroke, so they are things that cut

explanation.definitionFit: A cutter is a fast sailing vessel, and anything that cuts, as a club playing a cut shot does.

clue.text: I make people come in the end to old opera

parts.note: to do is to make or perform
men means people

indicators.note: only the last letter of the word come is used

explanation.surface: Someone vows to bring people to an old opera at last.
explanation.definitionFit: Idomeneo is an opera by Mozart, first staged in 1781.

clue.text: People cooperating pass book round

indicators.note: turned round, so the pieces are read backwards together

parts.note: a col is a mountain pass

explanation.surface: Collaborators hand a book around among themselves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' turns the whole run COLB backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A bloc is a group of nations or parties acting together for a common purpose.

clue.text: Casual coat, not so short, worn round university

indicators.note: the word for not so short goes around the abbreviation

parts.note: longer is the opposite of shorter

explanation.surface: A relaxed jacket, a bit longer, is worn around campus.
explanation.definitionFit: A lounger here is a lounge jacket, an informal coat for relaxing in.

clue.text: Having drunk rum, becomes awkward

indicators.note: being drunk means the letters stagger into a new order

explanation.surface: After downing some rum, a person becomes clumsy.
explanation.definitionFit: Cumbersome means unwieldy, clumsy and awkward to handle.

clue.text: Meeting normal practice

definitions.meaning: a formal assembly or conference of members
an accepted custom or usual way of doing things

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both a large formal gathering of delegates and an accepted social custom.

clue.text: What's chewed all round a US base?

indicators.note: the chewed substance goes all the way round the next letter

parts.note: gum is what one chews

explanation.surface: Chewing gum is stuck everywhere at an American military station.
explanation.walkthrough: Guam is a Pacific island hosting major American bases; 'all round' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Guam is a US territory in the western Pacific with large American air and naval installations.

clue.text: Out of self-interested attitude, press zero

parts.note: a press is a cupboard, especially for linen
love is zero in tennis scoring

explanation.surface: Acting from selfish motives, someone pushes down to nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'press' looks like a verb but is the noun for a cupboard; 'Out of' links.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means affection shown only for what one can get, as a pet loving whoever feeds it.

clue.text: Leading tropical area, real estate that's unloved

indicators.note: the word for real goes in front of the tropical region

parts.note: concrete means real or actual, as opposed to abstract
a jungle is dense tropical forest

explanation.surface: A leading rainforest region turns out to be real estate nobody likes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leading' tells you the synonym of 'real' comes first; 'real estate' looks like a phrase but splits across wordplay and definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes a grim built-up urban area of drab buildings, a place people dislike living in.

clue.text: Smart to trap opponent in bridge

indicators.note: the word for smart closes around the word for opponent

parts.note: clever means smart
anti means one opposed

explanation.surface: A clever card player tries to trap an opponent at the bridge table.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bridge' suggests the card game; it is a structure.
explanation.definitionFit: A cantilever bridge is built from arms projecting from piers, supported at one end only.

clue.text: Sudden fit about Birmingham losing millions

indicators.note: the word for fit goes around the shortened city name

parts.note: apt means fit or suitable
Brum is the informal name for Birmingham, England's second city

explanation.surface: A sudden attack strikes Birmingham, which loses millions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing' and 'about' are the two operations; Brum is the nickname for Birmingham. 'fit' looks like a seizure but is the adjective meaning suitable.
explanation.definitionFit: Abrupt means happening suddenly and without warning.

clue.text: Shrub is given to N African Muslim

parts.note: the Berbers are a largely Muslim people of North Africa

explanation.surface: A shrub is presented to a North African man.
explanation.definitionFit: Berberis is the botanical name of the barberry, a thorny garden shrub.

clue.text: A lad's reputation picked up, all agreed

parts.note: a son is a lad

indicators.note: in a down clue, picked up means read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: a name is a reputation

explanation.surface: A boy's good name is restored, with everyone in accord.
explanation.walkthrough: 'picked up' looks like a homophone signal, but in a down clue it turns NAME into EMAN.
explanation.definitionFit: As one man means unanimously, with everyone in agreement.

clue.text: Difficult or easy to get to laugh?

definitions.meaning: tricky or delicate, needing careful handling
sensitive to being tickled, so laughing readily

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both delicate or tricky and sensitive to tickling.

clue.text: In court, one has gold on as badge of rank

indicators.note: the pieces go inside the abbreviation for court
the gold sits on top of one in the down entry

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry
taken as written

explanation.surface: At court, someone wears gold as a mark of their rank.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'has gold on' places the heraldic gold above the number; 'In' puts both inside the court abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: A coronet is a small crown worn by peers to show their rank.

clue.text: German reversing second carriage

parts.note: Hans is a typical German man's name

indicators.note: the word for second is turned backwards

parts.note: a mo is a moment or second

explanation.surface: A German backs up a second carriage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reversing' turns MO into OM; the surface suggests a German driver reversing.
explanation.definitionFit: A hansom is a two-wheeled horse-drawn cab with the driver seated behind.

clue.text: Like theatre finally Lister organised?

indicators.note: the letters are organised into a new order
only the last letter of the word theatre is used

explanation.surface: An operating theatre the way Lister finally ran it.
explanation.walkthrough: Joseph Lister pioneered antiseptic surgery, making the operating theatre germ-free; 'theatre' suggests the stage.
explanation.definitionFit: Sterile means free from germs, as Lister's antiseptic methods made surgery.

clue.text: Run to church in warm coat

parts.note: to flee is to run away
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Someone dashes to church in a warm overcoat.
explanation.definitionFit: A fleece is a warm jacket made of soft synthetic pile fabric.

clue.text: Peers to see flower

definitions.meaning: the members of the House of Lords, men and women
a wild arum plant also called cuckoopint

explanation.definitionFit: Peers of the realm are lords and ladies, and the same name is the folk name of the wild arum.

clue.text: Piece of land lost in poor judgment

definitions.meaning: a small allotted area of ground
the idiom for losing one's grip on reason is to lose this, the storyline

explanation.definitionFit: A plot is a small patch of ground, and someone with poor judgment is said to have lost the plot.

clue.text: Blade's point is on the front

indicators.note: the compass point sits on the end of the word for front

parts.note: the van is the front of an army or procession
E is a compass point, east

explanation.surface: The tip of a blade is at its leading edge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'point' suggests a blade's tip, but it is a compass point.
explanation.definitionFit: A vane is a flat blade, as on a windmill or turbine, moved by wind or water.

clue.text: Self-identification? Right about one's being very old

parts.note: saying 'I'm me' identifies oneself

indicators.note: the word for right goes around the numeral

parts.note: moral means right or ethical
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone identifies themselves, and is right that they are very old.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts MORAL round I to give MORIAL; 's being' just links.
explanation.definitionFit: Immemorial describes something so ancient it is beyond memory or record.

clue.text: Girl — no lie — executed

indicators.note: beheaded, so the first letter goes

parts.note: the truth is the opposite of a lie

explanation.surface: A girl is put to death, and that's no lie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'executed' means beheaded: TRUTH loses its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruth is a girl's name, as in the biblical figure.

clue.text: At stake, surrender sacred books to prior

parts.note: an ante is the stake put up in poker
to cede is to give up
NT is the New Testament

explanation.surface: With much to lose, someone hands over holy books to a monastery's prior.
explanation.walkthrough: 'prior' looks like a monk but is the adjective meaning earlier.
explanation.definitionFit: Antecedent means going before in time, earlier.
